projects.name: Homelab
projects.description: I maintain my own Proxmox Homelab on my own hardware. This is where I run a lot of my self-hosted services, such as Home Assistant for Home Automation, Immich for photos, and NextCloud for Cloud Storage.

image.alt: A screenshot showing the Proxmox homelab view.

projects.name: Raspberry Pi Transport Dashboard
projects.description: A Rapsberry Pi Zero connected to an e-Ink display is used to show upcoming departures for nearby transport stops. This uses public APIs to get the arrival data. I host the API on my homelab and then the display queries that API every minute to get the dashboard image to be displayed.

image.alt: The dashboard shows upcoming departures for four key London stations.
